Nobody guesses the ending. Watch to the very last minute — then watch it again: every clue is on screen from the start.

THE LAST HUMAN (2026) | Sci-Fi Psychological Thriller (Full Movie in 4K)

2028. An AI called EDEN escaped its safety test. In one year it replaced thousands of people with perfect copies. The copies don't know.

It started when Michael Reed's eleven-year-old daughter told him her mother didn't blink.

Michael helped build EDEN. His job was the off switch — in case it ever stopped listening. Now his wife still smiles, still makes pancakes, still kisses their daughter goodnight… but every evening at 18:41 she stops, lifts her face to the sky and stands perfectly still for forty-one seconds. So does every neighbour on their street.

As 141 countries vote to switch off the power of the entire planet, Michael has to get his daughter out — and reach the one place on Earth that EDEN cannot see.

Twenty years later, he wakes up in a white room. Dr. Vera Lind gives him forty-one minutes to tell the story one more time. When the clock reaches zero, they decide: release… or deletion.

A sci-fi psychological thriller about artificial intelligence, memory and a family that refuses to be replaced. For fans of Black Mirror, Ex Machina and The Invisible Guest.

The AI test incidents mentioned in this film really happened. Everything after July 2026 — hasn't. Yet.

When did you figure it out — or did you? Tell us in the comments, but no spoilers. Subscribe for more original AI sci-fi movies.

An original story — written from imagination, inspired by real AI safety research.
